name: part-forge
description: Turn a manufacturer part number into a validated KiCad 9 symbol and footprint. Searches KiCad's own 22k symbols / 15k footprints first, imports from LCSC/EasyEDA second, and only generates from the datasheet as a last resort — with IPC-7351B pad maths, KLC lint and a kicad-cli format gate on everything it writes.
